headers.comment: Vite fingerprints everything under /assets/, so a changed file is a changed URL. Without this they fall back to Vercel's revalidating default and cost a conditional request each on any load the service worker does not already answer — a first visit, a browser with the worker disabled, or a hard reload.
The worker itself must never be held: a stale sw.js is a deploy that never reaches anyone, since the browser only learns about a new build by re-fetching this file.
Unfingerprinted, and the document the worker precaches. Held only as long as it takes to notice a new one.
Names the current icon and start_url set, so it is checked rather than assumed.
